items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 10:1
items.html: The three days of absorption are the discernment of the correction of the three lines, brought about by the coupling of AVI, of which a line and a half are corrected by Aba, and a line and a half by Ima. For Aba shines in the secret of the 32 Paths of Hochma, and divides the MAN of ZA into 320 discernments; and since he shines only to the nine [Sefirot] of each path, and does not shine to the Malchuyot of each path, it is found that he thereby rejects the 32 Malchuyot of each and every path back to BYA in the secret of waste, and shines and corrects the nine of each path in the secret of the whiteness within the offspring that comes from Aba, which is the secret of 288 sparks, since nine times 32 equals 288. And these 288 include the right line and the right half of the middle line — that is, the whole essence of the ten Sefirot of ZON, apart from the coarseness and the Malchuyot within them, since he rejected the whole discernment of Malchuyot within the 32 paths and brought them down to BYA, and nothing remained there but the essence of the Sefirot. This is the secret of the whiteness that Aba gives, since through Aba's clarifications nothing remained in the MAN of the offspring but the discernment of the right, called white, that shone, for there is nothing there of the discernment of Malchuyot and of the discernment of coarseness at all.
